title: /themes/services on the Nocturne page layout, with a real render of every surface and kept out of search until Services is offered
detail: app/(marketing)/themes/services/page.tsx draws the shared FrequencyThemeFeature (the template /themes/bold and /themes/wildheart use, built to the live Nocturne page) with Services copy in lib/themes/theme-feature-data.ts and SEO in lib/seo/frequency-pages.ts. The four surfaces are real renders (public/brand/theme-pages/services/, scripts/render/theme-pages-shots with THEME_ONLY=services): the General trade kit site, the Services Spotlight, the Space page and the welcome email, all in Tide. The Starter kits section lists the sixteen trade kits. robots noindex while Services stays hidden; /themes/[theme] no longer generates services.
